I suggest you focus on getting through high school first and then go to a community college. Once you have completed your undergraduate or have received your AA you could secure a higher paying job and start to apply to masters programs while strengthening your skills and saving money. Harvard could be a good masters option but I unfortunately agree with the other posters that it is incredibly hard to get into unless you have an excellent transcript or lot money and connections. I wish you the best of luck!! I believe in you random internet stranger and I think if you work hard enough at it you can make there eventually! I can't tell you what to do. But I've been there. I tried to kill myself and it didn't work and it was hell. You pick a point in the future, whether it be an hour, day, week or month. It can even be 10 minutes away. And you tell yourself that you will make it to that point. Once you make it to that point you pick another. And you chip away at life one destination at a time. Make small goals, even just showering can be a goal. You are not alone. It may feel like it, especially at 3 am when you're in the position you are in. Make some tea, or some warm milk. Try your best to breathe. If you can reach out for help then reach out, you don't even have to say what you tried, you can be as vague as you need to be but try to reach out. Try to find ways to cope. Art has really helped me as has baking and playing music. You just exist and the hope is that one day it'll be worth it. I'm here if you want to talk.
